tradeseeker.title: Trade Seeker
tradeseeker.subtitle: librarian re-roller
tradeseeker.help.2: 1. Put a lectern by a villager nobody has traded with.
tradeseeker.help.3: 2. Stand right up against the lectern, axe in your hotbar.
tradeseeker.help.4: 3. Pick books on the left; set level and price on the right.
tradeseeker.help.5: 4. Look at the villager and press Start. J opens this menu.
tradeseeker.help.6: Trading hall: an open iron trapdoor across the front of each
tradeseeker.help.7: pod keeps broken lecterns from falling in. With auto-buy, it
tradeseeker.help.8: moves on to the next villager for the books still wanted.
tradeseeker.help.9: Enter picks the selected book · Shift+Enter starts.
tradeseeker.need_world: Join a world to see the enchantments.
tradeseeker.none_picked: Nothing picked yet. Tick a book in All, or try the starter kit.
tradeseeker.kit.tip: Picks the books most people want, at their best level:
tradeseeker.combined.tip: The chance a re-roll turns up any of your picked books, as you've set them
tradeseeker.combined.never: %s picked · none can turn up as set
tradeseeker.seen.empty: Every offer a re-roll turns up is listed here, newest first, with near misses in gold.
tradeseeker.look_for.tip: Changing its level or price picks it too
tradeseeker.slider.tip: Drag the ends, or scroll over them (Shift: 5 at a time)
tradeseeker.band.tip: The gold band: for levels %1$s to %2$s, villagers ask %3$s to %4$s emeralds
tradeseeker.preset.any.tip: Take it at whatever it costs
tradeseeker.preset.half.tip: The cheaper half of what villagers ask
tradeseeker.preset.bargain.tip: The cheapest quarter: rarer, so it takes longer
tradeseeker.odds.never: Can't turn up: no villager asks a price in that range for those levels. Widen the price range.
tradeseeker.odds.tip.1: From the game's own trade rules
tradeseeker.odds.tip.2: 2 in 3 re-rolls offer a book; its enchantment and level are random.
tradeseeker.odds.tip.3: Times use your pace so far: %s s per re-roll.
tradeseeker.autobuy.tip.1: Buy the book the moment it turns up
tradeseeker.autobuy.tip.2: You need the emeralds and a book on you. Then it moves to the next untraded villager in reach for the other books.
tradeseeker.autobuy.tip.3: Off: it stops with the trade open and selected, and you decide.
tradeseeker.buymax: Buy as many as I can afford
tradeseeker.buymax.tip.1: Keep buying copies of the book
tradeseeker.buymax.tip.2: Until you run out of emeralds, books or space, or the villager runs out (12 at most).
tradeseeker.options.tip: Speed, safety, messages, a re-roll limit
tradeseeker.options.title: Options
tradeseeker.speed.fast.tip: Hardly waits between steps. Fine in single player.
tradeseeker.speed.normal.tip: Waits a moment between steps, like a quick player.
tradeseeker.speed.careful.tip: Waits longer between steps, for servers with a strict anticheat.
tradeseeker.opt.face: Turn to face the villager and lectern
tradeseeker.opt.face.tip: What a player would do; some servers check where you're looking
tradeseeker.opt.hurt.tip: So you can deal with whoever (or whatever) it is
tradeseeker.opt.near.tip: A wanted book at too low a level or the wrong price, said once in chat
tradeseeker.opt.limit.tip: Re-rolls before it gives up · Shift: 50 at a time
tradeseeker.check.pick.tip: Tick at least one book on the left
tradeseeker.check.villager.tip: The one you're looking at, or the nearest to where you look
tradeseeker.check.lectern.tip: Close enough to catch it when it drops
tradeseeker.check.axe.tip: The fastest tool in your hotbar is used (not one about to break)
tradeseeker.check.no_axe.tip: It works by hand, just slower. Put an axe in your hotbar.
tradeseeker.check.spares.tip: Used when a broken lectern lands out of reach
tradeseeker.check.emeralds.tip: A wanted book can cost up to %s
tradeseeker.check.books.tip: Each enchanted book costs a plain book too
tradeseeker.stop.tip: Stops now; the villager keeps whatever trades it has
tradeseeker.status.wait_jobless: Re-roll %s: waiting for the villager to lose its job…
tradeseeker.status.wait_job: Re-roll %s: waiting for the villager to take the lectern…
tradeseeker.status.wait_lectern: Waiting to pick up the lectern…
tradeseeker.msg.nothing_wanted: Pick at least one enchantment first (press J).
tradeseeker.msg.nothing_left: Nothing left to look for, so it stopped.
tradeseeker.msg.no_villager: No villager found. Look at the villager you want to re-roll and stand close to it.
tradeseeker.msg.nitwit: That's a nitwit (green coat). Nitwits never take a job.
tradeseeker.msg.no_lectern: No lectern in reach. Place one next to the villager and stand by it.
tradeseeker.msg.started: Re-rolling with the lectern at %s. Press J for the menu.
tradeseeker.msg.step_closer: Step right up against the lectern. From here you can't always catch it when it drops, and a lost lectern costs a spare.
tradeseeker.msg.hurt: You took damage, so it stopped.
tradeseeker.msg.too_far: You moved too far from the lectern, so it stopped.
tradeseeker.msg.too_far_villager: The villager is out of reach. Stand closer to it.
tradeseeker.msg.no_trades: The villager won't show its trades.
tradeseeker.msg.locked: Someone has traded with this librarian, so its trades are locked for good. Use one nobody has traded with.
tradeseeker.msg.max_rolls: Gave up after %s re-rolls (the limit you set).
tradeseeker.msg.your_call: It's selected in the trade screen. Take it from the result slot to buy it, or close the screen to leave it.
tradeseeker.msg.buy_closed: The trade screen closed before it could buy.
tradeseeker.msg.cant_afford: Couldn't buy it: you need the emeralds and a book on you. The trade is still there; the screen is open.
tradeseeker.msg.inventory_full: Your inventory is full, so there's nowhere to put the book. Make space and buy it from the open screen.
tradeseeker.msg.bought: Bought %s. That librarian's trades are now locked in.
tradeseeker.msg.next_villager: Moving to the next villager for: %s
tradeseeker.msg.no_next_villager: Still wanted: %s, but there's no other untraded villager in reach. Stand by the next one and press Start.
tradeseeker.msg.kept_job: The villager kept its job. It may have traded before, or claimed another lectern nearby.
tradeseeker.msg.spot_taken: The lectern's spot is blocked, or there is nothing solid to place it against.
tradeseeker.msg.no_lectern_item: No lectern in your inventory. Stand right next to it so you pick it up, or carry a spare.
tradeseeker.msg.drop_lost: A lectern dropped where you can't pick it up (into the pod?). It carries on with your spares (%s left). Tip: an open iron trapdoor across the front of the pod (between the villager and its lectern) stops drops falling in.
tradeseeker.msg.spares_low: Only %s lectern(s) left in your inventory.
tradeseeker.msg.other_job: The villager took a different job. Remove other job blocks near it.
tradeseeker.msg.stolen: A jobless villager next door took the lectern. Give the neighbours a job first, or wall them off.
tradeseeker.msg.no_job: The villager didn't take the lectern in 60 seconds. It has to be able to walk to it, and villagers don't take jobs while asleep.
